title: Transition Step from a Nonhalting Configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine, let $x$ be an input string, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. If the state of $c$ is $q$, then one step from $c$ is obtained by applying the transition action prescribed by $M$ at state $q$, using the symbols currently read on the input and work tapes.
